title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
contract: Merge two nondecreasing linked lists and return their sorted values.
brute: int[] out=new int[a.length+b.length];System.arraycopy(a,0,out,0,a.length);System.arraycopy(b,0,out,a.length,b.length);Arrays.sort(out);emit("Collect all values and sort","values",out);return out;
reasoning: Collect and sort values without using the fact that each list is already sorted.
The next global minimum must be one of the two heads. A dummy node handles the initial append uniformly.
Append the untouched suffix once a list empties. The merge rewires existing nodes in constant auxiliary space; demo input and output conversions allocate arrays/nodes.
complexity: O(n+m), O(1) merge auxiliary excluding conversion
